text:
rachel-sales: Hey team — Nimbus (fintech) POC needs a Dedicated pool for a live demo next Tues. They expect ~50 RPS, avg seq len ~256. Model is Llama-2 13B (we'll serve quantized). Asking: H100 vs A100 tradeoffs (latency/cost), recommended pool size, and a demo burst strategy. Prefer us-west1 if possible. CC @matt-se @zoe-se @alyssa-infra
matt-se: Quick clarifying q's — is the quant 4-bit or 8-bit? Will requests reuse KV cache (session chat) or be mostly stateless single-shot? Also target p95 latency?
zoe-se: If it's 4-bit Q8_0 or GPTQ-ish, H100 gives better perf per GPU for 13B; A100 needs more cluster-level batching. For 50 RPS with seq=256 and stateless single-shot, rough starting config: 3 x H100 (dedicated) with continuous batching and small concurrency slots -> should hit ~1200 tokens/s per GPU. If stateful (KV reuse) effective throughput higher, can drop to 2x H100.
alyssa-infra: Heads-up — H100 inventory in us-west1 is tight next week. us-west2 has capacity (latency +25ms to customer), or we can do mixed pool: 2xH100 primary + burst to hosted API for overflow.
diego-nimbus: We plan to use session chat with some context reuse, so KV cache helps. p95 target is <500ms for the demo. Security wise we need VPC peering or Private deployment for PCI review — is that possible for a POC?
matt-se: For p95<500ms, H100 is safer. With 3xH100 and proper batching + KV caches, we should be comfortably under 400ms p95 for single-shot. For stateful sessions, latency depends on cache hit patterns but should still be OK.
zoe-se: Cost sketch (monthly-rate equivalent, rough): 3xH100 dedicated pool steady = ~ $XXk/mo. 4xA100 alternative gives similar throughput but higher tail latency and slightly lower cost. If Nimbus needs short demo only, propose 7-day reserved pool + burst rules to hosted.
alyssa-infra: To request provisioning, fill this pool spec and we'll queue it. Example payload for infra team:
```json
{
  "customer": "nimbus",
  "env": "poc",
  "region": "us-west1",
  "pool": {
    "sku": "H100",
    "count": 3,
    "gpu_type": "h100-80gb",
    "network": "private-vpc",
    "access": ["rachel-sales","diego-nimbus","matt-se"]
  },
  "fallback": {
    "burst_to_hosted": true,
    "fallback_region": "us-west2"
  }
}
```
infra-bot: Provisioning checklist: capacity check -> quota -> VPC setup -> IAM grants -> test endpoint. Current status: capacity check pending (us-west1), us-west2 available.
rachel-sales: ok I'll ask Nimbus if us-west2 is acceptable and confirm the quant details. Also start contract note for 7-day pool and potential switch to dedicated monthly if they sign. :thumbsup:
diego-nimbus: us-west2 is OK if latency stays <500ms. We'll confirm quant type (likely 4-bit). Thx everyone.
zoe-se: If they confirm 4-bit, I'll prepare runtime config (batching policy, kv cache ttl, token limits) and run a local perf test to validate numbers.
alyssa-infra: Once you confirm region & quant, I'll open the pool request and tag infra-scheduling. ETA for us-west2: ~48 hours after request.
matt-se: Also recommend adding a canary route with smaller cohort to validate quality and latency before full traffic.
rachel-sales: great — I'll update here when Nimbus confirms. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
